question: Will Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) provide ≥1 assist vs Lazio on Nov 8, 2026 (regular + stoppage time only)?

model.prompt_context:

- "Yes": Wins if Kevin De Bruyne is officially credited with 1 or more assists in the Napoli vs. Lazio Serie A match on November 8, 2026, strictly after 2026-11-07T18:48:58.999Z and at or before 2026-11-08T19:30:00.000Z, counting only actions occurring during regular time and stoppage time (i.e., excluding extra time and penalty shootouts).
- "No": Wins if Kevin De Bruyne is officially credited with 0 assists in that match within the same window, or if he does not appear in the match (did not play) within that window.

Clarifications:
- An "assist" is defined as the official last touch or key pass credited to De Bruyne immediately before a goal is scored, as recorded in the official Serie A match statistics. Own goals do not count as goals for assist purposes and do not generate an assist.
- If the match is postponed, cancelled, or not completed before 2026-11-08T19:30:00.000Z, the market is unresolvable.
